children.text: Captures the LLM API traffic the BSH host mediates, via the http.exchange, model.request and model.response observe hooks. Host-mediated traffic only: metadata and redacted previews, never bodies or conversation text.
Live rows are rendered by the plugin's bsh_panel export from the newest 200 stored records (oldest evicted). Use the captures tool to query records.

items.title: captures
items.detail: query the newest redacted records, optional point filter

items.title: scope note
items.detail: not a system-wide sniffer; other processes' traffic is invisible
